title.th: อาหารเช้าของผม

learning_goals: Review familiar words and practise seven focus entries.
Complete four comprehension questions and three writing prompts.

language_notes.en: ข้าวต้ม is rice soup, with grains in broth. Do not assume it is the same dish as every type of congee.
language_notes.zh-TW: 本課的米湯料理是米粒在湯中的稀飯，不一定等同所有種類的粥。

language_notes.en: Thai classifiers follow the number: ไข่ต้มหนึ่งฟอง.
language_notes.zh-TW: 泰語量詞放在數字後面，例如一顆水煮蛋。

vocabulary_notes.en: Seven focus entries are marked for practice; some may be review words. Other unfamiliar expressions are supporting vocabulary with glosses. Previously encountered means listed in earlier generated lesson vocabulary, not mastered and not a complete comparison with your textbook bank.
vocabulary_notes.zh-TW: 七個重點詞供練習，部分可能是複習詞。其他陌生表達附有解釋。「曾接觸」僅指先前生成的課程詞表，不代表熟練，也不是與完整課本詞庫的比對結果。

pronunciation.reading_advice_en: Read whole phrases in context first. School romanization is not supplied in this draft. Your confirmed convention remains ก = k.

notes.th: แม่กินไข่ต้มหนึ่งฟอง

comprehension.question_th: วันนี้ผมกินอะไรเป็นอาหารเช้า
comprehension.question_en: What do I eat for breakfast today?
comprehension.hint_en: เป็นอาหารเช้า means as breakfast.
comprehension.explanation_en: The story says: วันนี้ผมกินข้าวต้ม — Today I eat rice soup.

comprehension.question_th: ในข้าวต้มมีอะไร
comprehension.question_en: What is in the rice soup?
comprehension.explanation_en: The story says: ในข้าวต้มมีไก่ — There is chicken in the rice soup.

comprehension.question_th: ผมใช้อะไรกินข้าวต้ม
comprehension.question_en: What do I use to eat rice soup?
comprehension.explanation_en: The story says: ผมใช้ช้อนกินข้าวต้ม — I use a spoon to eat rice soup.

comprehension.question_th: แม่กินไข่ต้มกี่ฟอง
comprehension.question_en: How many boiled eggs does my mother eat?
comprehension.hint_en: กี่ฟอง asks how many eggs.
comprehension.explanation_en: The story says: แม่กินไข่ต้มหนึ่งฟอง — My mother eats one boiled egg.

writing.personalization_en: Write two true sentences about your own routine using these patterns. Change the fictional details as needed.
writing.pronoun_note_en: The narrator uses ผม. Use ฉัน or another suitable self-reference when appropriate.

tasks.instruction_en: Read the 8 Thai sentences aloud slowly.
Hide the story and say three sentences about this topic using details from your own life.
